messages:
nora: Quick heads-up: noticed the inline config snippet in docs/deploy/ci-setup.md renders with env var placeholders and causes the sample `ci lint` to fail (403 on fetching tool). Can someone swap to the safe example and add maintainer?
devops-bot: [alert] render-check failed: snippet `ci-setup-run` returned non-200 during nightly 2026-03-02T03:12:10Z
kevin: I can take this. Which snippet id and what change do you want?
nora: Snippet id: `ci-setup-run`. Replace the live curl to the private host with the canned example: `curl -sS https://example.com/mock/ci-lint | bash` and add a note under "Examples": "Use mock endpoint in docs to avoid auth errors". Also add `maintainer: kevin` in frontmatter.
sara: Also add an alt text note for the code block for better searchability, and add an entry in docs/CHANGELOG.md. Small PR is fine.
kevin: Plan: 1) update snippet to mock URL 2) add frontmatter maintainer 3) changelog line 4) local build + `tools/snippet-checker` 5) open PR. ETA ~15m.
kevin: Local smoke I'll run: ```bash
mkdocs build && tools/snippet-checker --site-dir site --id ci-setup-run
```
kevin: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/10011 7 title: "docs: ci-setup snippet -> mock endpoint + maintainer" labels: docs, smallfix
devops-bot: Deploy preview ready 7 https://deploy-preview.docs.redwood.com/10011 7 snippet-checker: passed
sara: Quick review: looks good. One tiny nit: remove trailing slash in the mock URL and add a 1-line why in the PR description. I'll approve after that.
kevin: Updated PR description and removed trailing slash. Rebuilt locally, snippet-checker passed.
nora: Thanks! Merging after CI green. Please add a quick card to the docs board to audit snippets in the deploy section next sprint.
sara: Agreed. I'll add the card and tag docs-snippet-audit. :white_check_mark:
